project_name: Sistema Operativo Institucional de Iglesia - Guías e Instructivos de Módulo

design_philosophy.identity: E1 Anti-AI Designer - Fusion, Emotion First, Precision & Pedagogy
design_philosophy.theme_archetype: ORGANIC & LUXURY NAVY-DORADO (Trust, Honor, Sacred Order & Modern Clarity)

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight font-bold
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight font-semibold
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider

typography.anti_default_rules: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Headings must use Spectral (Serif) with warm luxury weight contrast. Overlines must be IBM Plex Mono with wide tracking [0.2em].

colors.tinted_grey_rule: Tint all neutral greys with 5% warm navy or soft gold hue (#0F172A / #F8FAFC) to maintain alive depth.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Internal padding of p-6 or p-8 inside bordered cards is MANDATORY to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_breakpoint: 390px responsive view with zero horizontal overflow, bottom drawer sticky CTAs, touch-friendly tap targets (min 44px).

grid_modes.dashboard_grid: High density grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grid_modes.guide_drawer: Sheet / Drawer overlay on right with w-full sm:max-w-xl max-h-screen overflow-y-auto p-6

guide_button_and_panel_system.button_style: Floating or inline action bar button with icon, gold hover glow, border-amber-500/40, data-testid='context-guide-trigger-[module_key]'.
drawer_features: Estados del módulo y su lógica
Paso a Paso interactivo guiado por controles reales
Impactos y Conexiones entre módulos (ej: Persona -> Célula -> Proceso)
Ejemplo práctico con contexto real institucional sin datos ficticios
guide_button_and_panel_system.interactive_tour: TourOverlay.js con resalte por data-testid, controles anterior/siguiente/salir, tooltip posicionado y animación suave.

image_urls.description: Equipo pastoral y líderes participando en sesión interactiva de entrenamiento.
Líderes de la iglesia operando la plataforma digital en equipo.

testing_attributes.rule: All buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, and interactive tour targets MUST have unique data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement complete frontend and backend guide engine. Backend serves /api/guides/{module_key} from backend/docs/module_guides.json and module_guides.py. Frontend renders ContextGuideButton across all pages without duplicate buttons, opening ModuleGuideDrawer with full tabbed breakdown (Visión, Paso a Paso, Impacto en Sistema, Roles, Tour Interactivo). Ensure 100% test coverage compliance and zero mobile overflow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain gradients without depth.
Do not use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for standard UI icons; use Lucide or Phosphor icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit hover, focus, and active states with proper APCA contrast.
Strictly follow JavaScript .js React file naming conventions for frontend components.
Ensure data-testid attributes are preserved and applied to all interactive controls.
